potential.name: TIP4P rigid water
potential.implementation: bench/reference/fast_calculators.py:FastTIP4P — vectorized evaluation of ase.calculators.tip4p.TIP4P (same parameters, virtual sites, O-O smooth truncation and force redistribution), validated against the ASE calculator
potential.citation: W. L. Jorgensen, J. Chandrasekhar, J. D. Madura, R. W. Impey, M. L. Klein, J. Chem. Phys. 79, 926 (1983), doi:10.1063/1.445869

parameters.truncation: smooth switching function on the O-O center distance (ASE tip4p scheme)

units.note: physical units; rigid water constrained with ase.constraints.FixBondLengths (O-H, O-H, H-H per molecule; vectorized as RigidWater, same SHAKE iteration) following the ASE water tutorial

protocol.description: N=256 TIP4P waters at rho=0.997 g/cm3 (L=19.7308 A): O sites on a 7^3 grid subset with random rigid orientations; FIRE relaxation (fmax 0.05 eV/A); Langevin NVT dt=1 fs, friction 0.05 per ASE time unit: 2.5 ps at 350 K (melt-in), 2.5 ps at 300 K, then 5 frames at 1.5 ps intervals at 300 K

min_pairs.note: Coulomb-only H sites: guard floor below any physical hydrogen-bond contact

gr_peaks.note: TIP4P O-O first peak at 300 K
